study.title: A Low-Cost UAV System and Dataset for Real-Time Weed Detection in Salad Crops
study.short_title: AgriAdapt dataset; Squeeze U-Net on Jetson Nano IoU 0.5545, 30.6 FPS, 5-10 W

segmentation.domain: real-time on-board weed detection in salad crops from UAV RGB imagery (binary weed vs background; salad rows treated as background), deployed on a low-cost custom hexarotor with onboard NVIDIA Jetson Nano
segmentation.best_model: Squeeze U-Net (deployed for real-time on-board inference): IoU 55.45, Accuracy 89.84%, Recall 59.36, F1 69.68 at 512x512. Note: LRASPP (MobileNetV3) achieves the highest offline accuracy on AgriAdapt (IoU 59.25, Accuracy 91.72%, F1 72.99) but only 18.8 FPS on the Jetson Nano.

dataset.name: AgriAdapt: 747 UAV-acquired RGB images (643 retained after quality control) of salad crops with weeds from two fields in Rome, Italy (Field_001: 322 images, 11 Sep 2023; Field_002: 321 images, 20 Oct 2023), pixel-annotated weed vs background, publicly released
dataset.note: Custom hexarotor, Arducam IMX519 16 MP (4608x3456) camera on 2-axis gimbal; ~5 m altitude, GSD 0.4 cm/px; images captured 1280x1280, normalized to 640x640 then 512x512 for training. 80/20 train/test split, weighted CE (0.1/0.9 background/weed) + L2 (1e-4). Total dataset collected 747, retained 643 - both cited in the paper.

segmentation.backbone: Squeeze U-Net (U-Net + Squeeze-and-Excitation, 2.5 M params); DeepLabV3 and LRASPP with MobileNetV3 backbones

mIoU.quote: Squeeze U-Net is the most parameter-efficient model with 2.5 million parameters and 6.6 GFLOPS. It achieves an IoU of 55.45 and an accuracy of 89.84%
mIoU.ambiguity: Binary weed/background segmentation; IoU reported at 512x512 for the deployed Squeeze U-Net. LRASPP reaches the highest IoU 59.25 (offline).

mPA.ambiguity: Accuracy reported is overall pixel accuracy (Eq. 2), not class-mean.

F1.ambiguity: F1 of the deployed Squeeze U-Net at 512x512 (LRASPP F1 0.7299 offline).

PA.quote: It achieves an IoU of 55.45 and an accuracy of 89.84%
PA.ambiguity: Overall/semantic-segmentation accuracy = (TP+TN)/total pixels; Squeeze U-Net at 512x512.

weed_F1.ambiguity: F1 reported for the weed-vs-background binary task, not as separate per-class weed/crop F1 (no crop_F1 counterpart; salad is background).

crop_F1.ambiguity: Salad is treated as background; no per-crop F1 reported.

edge.device: NVIDIA Jetson Nano (4 GB) onboard the UAV, powered by an independent battery (independent power supply from flight batteries)
edge.framework: PyTorch (trained on NVIDIA RTX 3090, 16 batch, Adam lr 1e-4 exp-decay 0.99, 500 epochs max w/ early stop); deployed with PyTorch on Jetson Nano GPU; quantization not applied

fps.quote: the measured inference times correspond to average frame rates of 30.6 FPS for Squeeze U-Net
fps.ambiguity: Model-only forward-pass throughput on Jetson Nano at 512x512 (LRASPP 18.8 FPS, DeepLabV3 17.7 FPS); full pipeline incl. preprocessing/postprocessing approx. 32-35 ms/frame.

latency_ms.quote: Squeeze U-Net required only 0.0327 s per image
latency_ms.ambiguity: Model inference latency at 512x512 on Jetson Nano (Table 8: 32.7 ms); preprocessing/postprocessing each contribute ~1-2 ms, so end-to-end per-frame ~32-35 ms.

power_w.quote: The board is capable of running modern deep learning inference tasks while consuming as little as 5-10 W of power
power_w.ambiguity: Board-spec power draw 5-10 W (Jetson Nano); per-image energy measured on the deployed system: 66.54 uAh (Squeeze U-Net), vs 109.04 uAh (LRASPP) and 113.56 uAh (DeepLabV3). Not a direct wattmeter measurement.

params_M.quote: Squeeze U-Net is the most parameter-efficient model with 2.5 million parameters
params_M.ambiguity: Deployed Squeeze U-Net (LRASPP 3.2 M, DeepLabV3-MobileNetV3 11.0 M).

gflops.ambiguity: Compute reported by authors as 'GFLOPS' (= GFLOPs, per Table 4); structural figure at 512x512 input.

issues: AgriAdapt image count cited ambiguously (747 collected vs 643 retained after quality control); 643 recorded per Section 3.2/Table 3.
Deployed metrics recorded for Squeeze U-Net (real-time on-board model); LRASPP holds the highest offline accuracy (IoU 59.25, Acc 91.72) - noted in ambiguity.
Binary weed/background task (salad = background) with low weed recall (59.36) due to class imbalance.
Power cited as board-spec 5-10 W (not a per-model wattmeter measurement); energy reported per-image in uAh on the deployed Jetson Nano.
Single-crop (salad) dataset; detection not closed-loop to actuation.
